items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: Johnny Mince was in the band before I got in it... we had in that band... Johnny Mince

ctx.x: And Johnny Mince, of course, and so I say we were with that for 18 months, but when you turn this over, because the story I tell will take a few minutes. Ray Noble was not aware that English and American were
two different languages and actually I became interpreter because in my travels, I was sort of an Anglo-philé and I used to go. --
